program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let loop ([remaining (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 8))))] [out g])
    (if (empty? remaining)
        out
        (let* ((start (first remaining))
               (region (connected-region g (first start) (second start)
                         (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 8))) 4))
               (colors (remove-duplicates
                         (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 8))))
                                 (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) region))))
               (next-remaining (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p region))) remaining)))
          (if (= (length colors) 1)
              (loop next-remaining (paint-cells out region (first colors)))
              (loop next-remaining out))))))
